basics.name: Rik Koncel-Kedziorski
basics.label: ML Scientist, Apple
basics.summary: My research focuses on new methods for reasoning from data, human-computer collaboration, and improving evaluation of AI systems. Previously, I worked on those same things plus question answering, language grounding, and pragmatic meaning representation.

work.name: Apple
highlights: Developed reinforcement learning algorithms for learning user preferences through multi-turn interactions and behavioral simulation
Invented novel methods for personalizing generative AI systems
Drove cross-functional teams to integrate reasoning into multimodal LLM systems
Led research on synthetic data generation for training user-adaptive models

work.name: S&P Global, Kensho
highlights: Secured $100M+ investment for LLM development through technical leadership and strategic vision
Developed user-centered data and algorithms for financial NLP
Integral to defining company's Generative AI strategy with focus on financial reasoning

work.name: Amazon
highlights: Created scalable generative QA systems for Alexa
Developed novel approaches for RAG and multilingual QA

work.name: University of Washington CSE
highlights: Conducted foundational research on language understanding and generation for scientific domains
Supervised 8 student researchers under PI Noah Smith on projects involving human-AI interaction and dialog systems
Published influential work on LLM evaluation and graph-based reasoning
